scope: Static local review of the V4 scorer source contract and its exact V4 binding/source-manifest shapes. This records a deterministic source-level rejection before scoring; it is not an export or quality result.

finding.consumer_expression: source_file_pins = {item.get("path"): item for item in source_manifest["files"] if isinstance(item, dict)}; any(item != source_file_pins.get(relative) for relative, item in api_files.items())
finding.effect: The V4 consumer compares each {bytes, sha256} binding value against a full {path, bytes, sha256} source-manifest row. Every canonical API comparison is false, so _read_export_bundle rejects the binding before scoring.
finding.exporter_contract_note: The V4 exporter correctly validates the compact binding row against {"path": relative, **expected}; the mismatch is in the V4 score consumer normalization, not a corrupt source manifest.
finding.repair_condition: Rebase the consumer comparison to normalize the full manifest row to the compact binding shape, or version the producer binding and all pins to carry the full row consistently; add a focused full _read_export_bundle metadata fixture before claiming a producer/consumer PASS.

limitations: No scorer fixture, import, export, or scoring run was performed by this reviewer.
This rejection does not assess current B state, successful prediction export, metrics, or model quality.
The V3 source-review snapshot is included as historical context; it does not override the exact V4 consumer expression and row shapes inspected here.
reviewer_conclusion: Do not treat the current frozen V4 producer/consumer pair as compatible. The V4 exporter’s source checks accept the compact API pin objects, but the scorer contract compares them to full source-manifest rows without normalization and therefore rejects them.
